svg.title: rag-etl — the pipeline in one picture
svg.text: rag-etl — the pipeline in one picture
one fixed sequence for every project: sources in, an Elasticsearch index and a manifest out
Project — one file per project: projects/semester_*/<id>.py
sources: configured extractors · language · dir under $BASE_PATH
overrides: where-globs → type, subtype, number, week, cut… or exclude
professors exclude material themselves with NO_BOT markers
all read by a vision model
4 — judge: infer metadata and the cut
today a stub: title cues, inheritance down the tree, default cuts
no model or prompt in the key: --refresh <step> or a recipe version bump · PDFs and videos as Merkle trees: one changed page re-reads one page
ids and hashes, no text, no vectors
MCP server loop — built in the MCP server's repository, not here
refinement loop, while questions are missed

g.text: 1 · dry run: every step, nothing published
2 · read the manifest: labels, counts, coverage
3 · overrides where the labels are off (a line each)
4 · real run, then the weekly timer
something off in a manifest → override + rerun;
The resource tree — one recursive Resource for every level, one tree per source
no fixed depth: a zip in a zip, or a file straight to a chunk · nesting is the only relation between resources · deep links travel down as url (#page=N, timestamps)
indexed per chunk: content, embedding, lineage, url, type, subtype, number, subnumber, week, exercise_parts, has_solution, from, until — nothing project-level
labels are inherited down the tree unless a node states its own; overrides correct any node; exclude=True drops a subtree
